added_comments.text: # Percent-encode keys and values so reserved characters in user-supplied
# values (e.g. spaces or "&" in account names) cannot corrupt the query
# string or produce a request target the origin rejects with 400.

rationale: The diff replaces the naive unencoded query-string builder with proper percent-encoding (urlencode with quote) and encodes the path segment in get_export, which fixes the whole class of inputs with reserved characters rather than adding an entry to FLAKY_ENDPOINTS. It does not touch list_reports' naive Bogota-local timestamp behavior. The single added multi-line comment explains the non-obvious reason for encoding (origin rejects malformed targets with 400), so it is a 'why' comment; the test-file comments are also explanatory but live in tests.
